reason: A DeepSeek Harness plugin for discovering, searching, transforming, and importing historical sessions from claude-code, codex, reasonix, and zcode, with workspace binding and preserved supported tool context.

summaries.zh: 将 claude-code、codex、reasonix 和 zcode 的历史聊天记录发现、解析并导入为可继续使用的 DeepSeek Harness 会话。
summaries.en: Discover, parse, and import historical chats from claude-code, codex, reasonix, and zcode into resumable DeepSeek Harness sessions.

capabilities: Reads and parses local session history files from supported tools
Transforms and imports historical conversations into dsh sessions
Binds imported sessions to workspaces and preserves supported tool-call context
Provides a web interface and command for session discovery, search, and batch import
